issues.detail: The Chinese adds '因他們玷污了' (because they defiled) which has no basis in the Hebrew. The Hebrew reads 'עַל גָּאֳלֵי הַכֹּהֻנָּה' — 'on/against the defilements of the priesthood' (or 'for the defilements of the priesthood'), not 'because they defiled the priesthood.' The verb '玷污' (defile) is not present in the Hebrew; the noun 'גָּאֳלֵי' (defilements) is mistranslated as a verb phrase.
